note: Typed in by hand from official NASA/JPL pages. NOT a dataset and NOT downloaded by scripts/fetch-data.mjs. Every value has the page it was read from and a short quote. Opened on accessedAt.

marsSurfaceAbsorbedDose.what: Curiosity RAD, average absorbed dose rate from galactic cosmic rays on the surface of Mars (Gale Crater)
marsSurfaceAbsorbedDose.quote: contribute a slowly varying dose rate of about 210 micrograys per day

sept2017MarsSurface.what: Sept 2017 solar event at Mars: RAD surface radiation more than doubled (no number given on the page)
sept2017MarsSurface.quote: radiation levels on the surface more than double any previously measured by the Curiosity rover's Radiation Assessment Detector

stormTauPeak.what: 2018 global dust storm, last tau measured by Opportunity (10 June 2018)
stormTauPeak.quote: the last tau measured by Opportunity was 10.8 on June 10
stormTauPeak.conflict: https://science.nasa.gov/resource/on-mars-light-is-energy/ gives 10.5 for the same day; the game uses 10.8 (two JPL pages). Either value gives the same game number.

stormTauNormal.quote: an average tau for its location on Mars is usually 0.5

stormTauRecharge.what: Tau below which JPL expected Opportunity could recharge its batteries
stormTauRecharge.quote: Opportunity will need a tau of less than 2.0 ... recharge its batteries

opportunityLowestEnergy.what: Opportunity's energy on 10 June 2018, lowest measured at that time
opportunityLowestEnergy.quote: Energy level on that day (21 watt-hours) was the lowest ever measured on Opportunity at that time.

flareClassDefinition.value: C = 1e-6, M = 1e-5, X = 1e-4 W/m^2 (peak 1-8 Å X-ray flux); the number after the letter is the multiplier
flareClassDefinition.what: GOES flare classes, used by content/data.ts flareStrength()
flareClassDefinition.quote: The number is the multiplier needed to specify the exact peak flux.
